clue.text: Varied sound with treasonable broadcaster's backing

indicators.note: going backwards, so the broadcaster's nickname is read from its end to its start

parts.note: Lord Haw-Haw was the nickname of William Joyce, who broadcast Nazi propaganda to Britain and was hanged for treason

explanation.surface: A sound with variations is given support by a traitor on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' looks like support, but it turns HAW-HAW round.
explanation.definitionFit: A wah-wah is the wavering sound made by a guitar pedal or muted trumpet, a sound that varies in tone.

clue.text: Shakespeare's Niamh (who shall be nameless) shakes before 25 26 23

parts.note: the playwright's own first name, as in his punning sonnets, is Will

indicators.note: the Irish name loses its N, the standard abbreviation for name

parts.note: N is the abbreviation for name
an ague is a fever with fits of shivering, so the shakes

explanation.surface: An Irish girl in Shakespeare, discreetly unnamed, trembles before a later figure.
explanation.walkthrough: Tory leaders theme: this man led the Conservative Party from 1997 to 2001, before the leader named at 25, 26 and 23. The Irish girl's name loses its N.
explanation.definitionFit: He led the British Conservative Party immediately before the leader named at 25, 26 and 23, so he came before him.

clue.text: See 1
A sitter could be a performer

indicators.note: the letters of the two words could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: Someone posing for a portrait might turn out to be an entertainer.
explanation.definitionFit: An artiste is a professional entertainer such as a singer or dancer, a performer on stage.

clue.text: Return of old king without note in a group

indicators.note: in the old sense of outside, so one piece goes round the other
the monarch's name comes back, read from its end

parts.note: Old King Cole is the merry old soul of the nursery rhyme
NB, nota bene, is a written note meaning take note

explanation.surface: A former monarch comes back without a musical note, all together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return of' reverses the king's name to ELOC; 'without' means outside here. 'note' tempts towards a musical letter.
explanation.definitionFit: En bloc is French for all together as one unit, which is acting in a group.

clue.text: Girl's number with commercial break

definitions.note: read as girl is, the 's being the verb that links definition and wordplay

indicators.note: the advert interrupts the number, splitting it apart

parts.note: nine is a number
an ad is a commercial on television

explanation.surface: A girl's song on the radio is interrupted by an advert break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'commercial break' reads as one phrase, but the advert breaks into the number.
explanation.definitionFit: Nadine is a woman's given name, so any girl so called fits.

clue.text: Little boy traps female into consent for promotion of photosynthesis

indicators.note: the boy's name closes round everything else, holding it inside

parts.note: Len is a short form of Leonard, a boy's name made little

indicators.note: the abbreviation for female goes inside the word for consent

parts.note: to agree is to consent

explanation.surface: A small boy coaxes a woman into agreeing to support plant science.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts F inside the consent word, making AFGREE, and 'traps' wraps the little boy round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaf-green is an old name for chlorophyll, the pigment that drives photosynthesis in plants.

clue.text: Flier, predator and prey get punishment — time in prison

parts.note: a cat is a typical hunter of small animals
a bird is what a cat preys on

explanation.surface: A bird, a hunter and its victim all get punished with a spell inside.
explanation.walkthrough: The rest of the clue gives the same letters again: CAT is punishment (the cat-o'-nine-tails) and BIRD is British slang for a prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: The catbird is an American songbird, named for its mewing call, so it is a creature that flies.

clue.text: One who had miracle to work — not all day, it was said

definitions.text: not all day, it was said

indicators.note: the letters are set to work, reorganised into a new order

explanation.surface: A person given a miracle to perform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to work' rearranges WHO HAD MIRACLE. Ann Widdecombe famously said this Tory leader had 'something of the night' about him, hence not all day.
explanation.definitionFit: A colleague's remark that the politician had something of the night about him implies he is not entirely of the day.

clue.text: Flower to wilt

definitions.meaning: an iris, a plant with sword-shaped leaves

explanation.definitionFit: Flag names the iris family of flowers and is also a verb meaning to droop through tiredness.

clue.text: Another person 8 doesn't want to 15

definitions.meaning: someone outside the two main parties to an agreement, as in insurance
the Tory leader at 8 does not want to head the party placed behind the two big ones

explanation.definitionFit: A third party is an outsider to a deal, and also the minor political party behind the two main rivals.

clue.text: Various people taking the plunge

definitions.meaning: an old adjective meaning several or sundry

explanation.definitionFit: Divers is an archaic word for several or sundry, and is also the plural of a person who dives.

clue.text: Worker's control of portable luggage?

parts.note: a hand is a worker, as in farmhand
a grip is a travelling bag, a holdall

explanation.surface: A labourer takes charge of a bag he can carry.
explanation.definitionFit: A handgrip is a grasp or hold, so it signifies having control of something.

clue.text: Fish on pole Pooh had just time for

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: S is the South Pole
the mackerel is a sea fish

explanation.surface: Winnie-the-Pooh fishes from a pole, with just enough time.
explanation.walkthrough: In A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh stories, Pooh always finds it is time for 'a little smackerel of something', a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: Pooh's word for a little snack, which he always declared there was just time for in A. A. Milne's books.

clue.text: Many moult when young at the end

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, hence many
to moult is to lose feathers or hair
down is the soft first plumage of young birds

explanation.surface: Lots of creatures shed fluffy feathers as they grow up.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a natural history fact, but 'Many' is C, a hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: A close-down is the end of a day's broadcasting or of a business, so the finish.

clue.text: 8 intends to get a bullet out of the heart

parts.note: lead is the metal of bullets, and a bullet is often so called
from means out of
the heart of something is its middle

explanation.surface: A Tory leader means to have a bullet removed from his chest.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tory leader at 8 promised to govern from the political middle ground.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a centrist leadership pledge, which is what the leader at 8 said he would do.

clue.text: See 15
Unreasonable French cockney 8?

indicators.note: Londoners in the cockney dialect drop their aitches

parts.note: the surname of the Tory leader at 8 down

explanation.surface: A Frenchman speaking like a Londoner is a wilful politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cockney' drops the H from the surname at 8, giving OWARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Froward is an archaic word for perverse and difficult to deal with, so unreasonable.

clue.text: See 15
Russian-owned American girl

definitions.meaning: the London football club bought by the Russian Roman Abramovich
a girl's name popular in the US, as borne by Bill Clinton's daughter

explanation.definitionFit: Chelsea is a London football club owned by a Russian oligarch, and a female given name in America.

clue.text: High point of the student year and all that jazz

definitions.text: High point of the student year
definitions.meaning: ..., the week British students hold charity stunts
the syncopated piano music that led to jazz

explanation.definitionFit: Ragtime is an early syncopated style that fed into jazz, and rag time is British student charity week.

clue.text: A sequel to the European dream isn't good for the soul

indicators.note: a sequel comes after, so the A follows the other piece

parts.note: Traum is German for dream, German being a European language

explanation.surface: A follow-up to the dream of European unity harms the spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the European dream' points to the political idea, but it is the German word for dream.
explanation.definitionFit: Trauma is a deep psychological wound, something damaging to the mind and spirit.

clue.text: Order in ancient language for private consumption

indicators.note: the order's letters are set inside the language

parts.note: Hebrew is the ancient language of the Old Testament
OM is the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: An instruction written in an old tongue is meant only for personal reading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Order' looks like a command; it is OM, the Order of Merit.
explanation.definitionFit: Home-brew is beer made at home, for drinking oneself rather than for sale.

clue.text: 9 officer

definitions.meaning: the answer to 9 across in its sense of a banner
a junior commissioned officer in the US Navy, or formerly the army's flag-bearer

explanation.definitionFit: An ensign is a flag flown by ships, and also a junior officer rank.

clue.text: See 25
Playing soldiers with fellow artist's productions

parts.note: a man is a fellow
an artist's oeuvre is their body of work

explanation.surface: Children playing at war alongside a painter's works.
explanation.definitionFit: Manoeuvres are military exercises, troops practising, so soldiers at play.

clue.text: A nut can diminish potential, hence came 8

indicators.note: the letters have the potential to form something else

explanation.walkthrough: 'potential' rearranges A NUT CAN DIMINISH. This leader preceded the one at 8.
explanation.definitionFit: He was Conservative leader from 2001 to 2003 and was succeeded by the man at 8, who came after him.

clue.text: See 25
Potato that's turned to iron?

parts.note: mash is mashed potato
ie is id est, that is

explanation.surface: A potato that has been transformed into metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A mashie is an old golf club, equivalent to a five iron.
